note: Small, free Modoc NF campground on a loop beside South Fork Davis Creek in the Warner Mountains, near the town of Davis Creek. The Forest Service calls the road in rough, so it suits smaller rigs; a short drive from the Middle Fork Davis Creek Mine. --Claude
summary: Plum Valley (Modoc NF): free, first-come (no rec.gov listing), 7 sites, 14-day limit; FS says NO restrooms (stored vault toilets cleared to false), no water; season May-Oct (generally June-Oct); 'rough road' caveat; website and phone given.
